stem.text: The photomicrograph shows a section through a plant organ.

stem.alt: Photomicrograph of a cross-section through a plant organ with a square outline, showing a central region of small cells and darker patches near each corner.

stem.text: Which statement could be used to describe this organ?

A.text: The central region of this organ has supporting tissue.

B.text: The endodermis tissue is a thick layer around the edge of the organ.

C.text: The epidermis tissue in this organ has extensions (trichomes).

D.text: The xylem tissue is found in greatest density in the centre of the organ.
